title: targeting
summary: MSUI has immediate local selection with CMSG_SET_SELECTION publication, nameplate-first hover, nearest unit/GameObject arbitration, world-occlusion rejection, service/attack/loot cursor classification, target/hover model brightening at the exact 64/255 additive lift, reaction/combat-flash ring tint, a projected ground-targeting reticle, and current Benilla's scored forward/reverse enemy scan. Unit world picking now broad-phases against the active animation's authored bounds and narrow-phases against the exact last-drawn posed triangles, including hidden-geoset filtering and both rider and mount geometry. The second pass applies the reference one-model-unit skinned-normal halo with sticky previous-hover, alive, dead, then distance priority; skipped/culled render poses are not clickable and world geometry rejects only when strictly nearer. The stock UnitSelectTexture is camera-oriented and projected onto the existing ADT/WMO/doodad ground-decal receiver rather than drawn as a floating flat quad; it hides with no receiving surface. The same-GUID alive-to-dead edge clears selection and attack, while deliberately selecting an already-dead corpse remains valid. The exact hovered unit/GameObject/ground point is frozen on the first primary-button down edge, survives camera-look hover suppression and movement beneath the cursor, and is cancelled by a two-button camera chord. The persisted Sticky Targeting Interface option uses the reference default (empty left-click clears) and inverted checkbox semantics (enabled preserves the current target only on an empty left-click); Escape and real-unit selection remain unchanged.

openItems.text: Unit world picking still intersects a conservative vertical cylinder. Current Benilla broad-phases against the live animation sequence bounds and narrow-phases against the posed skinned render triangles, falling back to the render-mesh AABB only for hull-less/model-less units.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: TargetMeshPickLaw mirrors the GPU's four-weight skinning and last-drawn absolute unit transform, filters non-rendered geosets, broad-phases on the active sequence's authored sphere, then performs two-sided exact-triangle and +1-model-unit normal-inflated passes. GameLoop applies the reference sticky/alive/dead/distance halo ladder, includes mount and rider poses as one target, admits only renderer-published bodies, and uses strict-nearer world occlusion. Focused TargetMeshPick and full interface suites pass.

openItems.text: Focused TargetMeshPick and full interface suites pass. Live-verify exact silhouette hover on animated creatures/players, the generous halo at body edges, previous-hover anti-flicker, alive-over-corpse overlap, hidden equipment geosets, mounted rider+steed ownership, out-of-scene bodies, and strict terrain/WMO/doodad occlusion ties.

ClientWindow preserves the press pixel through an ordinary click, but GameLoop re-picks the world at release. Current Benilla latches the exact hovered unit/GameObject/occlusion/cursor verdict on the first primary-button down edge, so movement beneath that pixel before release cannot change the gesture's subject.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: TargetPressPickLaw freezes the previous-frame unit, GameObject and accepted ground point on the first primary-button down edge before camera look clears hover. The matching release consumes that subject; a two-button chord cancels both latches, and a same-frame click with no sampled down frame retains the press-pixel fallback. Focused TargetPressPick and full interface suites pass.

openItems.text: Empty left-click always clears the selected target. Current Benilla gates that leg through the reference deselectOnClick CVar exposed as the inverted Sticky Targeting option; MSUI has no equivalent player setting yet.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: ControlSettings now persists StickyTargeting with the reference default off (deselectOnClick=1). The Interface options page and search catalog expose the checkbox, and TargetClickLaw preserves the current target only for an empty ordinary left-click while enabled; real picks and Escape clearing are unchanged. Focused TargetClick and full interface suites pass.

openItems.text: Focused SelectionRing and full interface suites pass. Live-verify UnitSelectTexture projection across ADT slopes, WMO floors and collision doodads; camera-relative faded edge; no-ground hiding; unit occlusion; reaction/combat-flash tint; mounted footprint; same-target death clearing; and deliberate corpse re-selection.

Focused TargetPressPick and full interface suites pass. Live-verify click subject stability while a unit walks away before release, click-drag camera hover suppression, GameObject versus unit nearest ownership, ground-target cursor commit, two-button run/camera cancellation, UI capture, and editor/free-view click ownership.

Focused TargetClick and full interface suites pass. Live-verify Sticky Targeting default-off migration, Options Cancel/Okay/Defaults/preset persistence, search result navigation, empty terrain/sky left-click preservation when enabled, real-unit replacement, right-click actions, Escape clearing, and editor/free-view ownership.
